full_judgment: 8. We have perused the writ petitions along with the annex tires annexed thereto. it is true that the appellate Division in the aforesaid decisions has held that special provision for appeal having been made for challenging the judgment and decree passed by the Artha Rin  Adalat no application under Article 102 o the constitution lies against the same. Again, in the case of Zahirul Islam reported in 46 DLR (AD) 191 the Appellate Division held that the question of limitation and in excess of the Court's jurisdiction are matters to be agitated in appeal not under the writ, petition and the aforesaid view of the aforesaid decision has been affirmed by the Appellate Division in the case of Bangladesh Agriculture Development Corporation Vs. Artha Rin Adalat and others reported in 59 DLR (AD) 6.But again in the case of Managing Director. Rupali Bank Ltd and others Vs. Tafazal Hossain and others reported in DLR (AD) 260 the Appellate Division held that the jurisdiction of the court goes to the cry root of the matter brought before it and of the court got no jurisdiction everything shall fall through under such circumstances let us now see whether the impugned judgment and decree passed by the Adalat under section 13(1) of the Ain 2003 are in excess of jurisdiction.
